{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794678256325,"sessionID":"ses_e24db10f8ffeu0oRsCGULGwzns","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"write","callID":"PAZRCPjfod5pVFqR","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"filePath":"/app/rrt_planner.py","content":"import numpy as np\n\ndef generate_alpha_curve(num_points=200):\n    # Parametric curve for alpha tube\n    t = np.linspace(0, 2 * np.pi, num_points)\n    # Alpha shape curve in 3D\n    x = 0.5 * np.sin(t)\n    y = 0.8 * np.sin(2 * t)\n    z = 0.5 * np.cos(t)\n    return np.stack([x, y, z], axis=-1)\n\ncurve_a = generate_alpha_curve()\nprint(\"Generated curve_a with shape:\", curve_a.shape)\n"},"output":"Wrote file successfully.","metadata":{"diagnostics":{},"filepath":"/app/rrt_planner.py","exists":false,"truncated":false},"title":"app/rrt_planner.py","time":{"start":1794678256319,"end":1794678256323}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1db28f2bb001nZeAxYglN9IBCa","sessionID":"ses_e24db10f8ffeu0oRsCGULGwzns","messageID":"msg_1db28def5001iSzBJRAYdER6NT"}}
